decisions.reason: The semi-transparent bouclé-effect fabric only ever had a light website mention and no 2024 presence is reported, so public commitment is weak, but it still fits the decorative range and its slow uptake can be attributed to a short time on the market.
The flame-retardant jacquard reflects development investment, had its own page and serves the contract and hospitality segment the firm emphasizes, so management will persist with it.

The double-face wool-blend fabric uses renewable fiber in line with the announced sustainability direction, which justifies keeping it even though its visibility is modest and collection rotation adds some risk.
The wool bouclé leno required development effort and supports the shift toward renewable materials, so management will treat weak results as temporary and keep it.
The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 with its own website page, a strong and recent public commitment that management will not reverse after one year.
